input.note:
**Root Cause:** The new cart-service 4.2 deployment uses the standard Helm chart labels (app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/instance, app.kubernetes.io/version) but the Service selector still specifies `app: cart-service`. This label mismatch means the Service has no endpoints to route traffic to, causing connection refused errors.

**Evidence:** 
- Cart-service pods are Running and Ready with labels: app.kubernetes.io/name=cart-service, app.kubernetes.io/instance=cart-service, app.kubernetes.io/version=4.2.0
- Pod logs show 0 requests in the last 60s (no traffic reaching them)
- Storefront logs show "dial tcp 10.96.47.12:8080: connect: connection refused" when trying to reach the cart-service ClusterIP

**Fix:** Update the Service selector to match the new pod labels. Change the Service spec.selector from `{app: cart-service}` to `{app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service}`, or alternatively add the `app: cart-service` label to the pod template in the new Helm chart to maintain backward compatibility with the existing Service selector.
